specs.title: TC01: Empty cart shows a friendly message and shopping link
TC02: Empty-cart shopping link returns to home
TC03: CSV product iPhone 15 Pro Max has correct quantity and subtotal
TC04: CSV product Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra has correct quantity and subtotal
TC05: CSV product MacBook Pro M3 has correct quantity and subtotal
TC06: CSV product Tai nghe AirPods Pro 2 has correct quantity and subtotal
TC07: Multiple products produce the exact total
TC08: Removing one item updates the cart
TC09: Removing the last item returns to empty state
TC10: Unauthenticated checkout shows warning and redirects to login
TC11: Authenticated checkout opens the checkout page
TC12: @bug Re-adding a product increases quantity without a duplicate row
